Definition: Adiel, the name of three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Adiel = "ornament of God"; 1) a prince of the Simeon of the family of Shimei in the time of king Hezekiah of Judah; 2) a priest, ancestor of Maasiai; 3) ancestor of Azmaveth, the treasurer of David
